lines.en: -Count of three, we're all gonna put down our guns.
-We'll put down our weaponry on the count of three.
-And he revealed himself to be a double agent,
at which point Dwight felt comfortable
revealing that he also was a double agent,
and then Michael announced to everybody that,
get this, he was a double agent.
Oh, and it is six o'clock.
I'm not going down for this!
-Get the keys out of my purse, start the car.
